title: The Sediment of Unchosen Paths

features.name: the forking sediment
features.desc-on-touch: two paths visible in crosssection, one above the other, divided by a single moment. both are equally real here, equally preserved.

features.name: the marker-stones of decision
features.desc-on-touch: each one stands where a choice was not made. the archive keeps them as witnesses to contradiction.

features.name: the tether running between both ways
features.desc-on-touch: a line connecting the two paths, keeping them from drifting entirely apart. the archive will not let contradiction become separation.

features.name: the residue of the other choice
features.desc-on-touch: dust and pollen from the path not taken. you can still read its scent, still see where it would have led.

features.name: the gate where both arguments remain standing
features.desc-on-touch: neither side has won. neither path has been closed. the gate holds them both open, proving contradiction is a kind of truth.

inscription: sediment remembers all the steps that were not taken; here, every path that might have been is as real as the one that was

file.name: Archive_Contradiction_Ledger_Both_Versions.txt
file.note: alternate histories filed together without hierarchy; the archive learned to shelve disagreement as its own kind of fact

exits.label: back to where both paths learned to read each other without erasing
downward to where the deepest sediments hold the oldest choices
toward where paths remember what they might have become
to the edge where contradiction becomes landscape
